summary.headline: Filter device-properties table formatting refreshed
summary.summary: The article date is updated and spacing is normalized for the iOS/iPadOS Managed property row.

summary.headline: Update ring automatic behavior options documented
summary.summary: The policy reference expands Automatic update behavior with Notify download, maintenance-time installation and restart, scheduled installation, no end-user restart control, and reset-to-default behavior, including Active Hours and AllowAutoUpdate references.
summary.adminImpact: Choose the automatic behavior and active-hours approach that matches restart and user-notification requirements.

summary.headline: Update ring reference removes retired user controls
summary.summary: The reference removes Restart checks (EDU Restart), the user option to pause updates, and the user option to check for updates while retaining expanded automatic update behavior guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Use Settings Catalog if an existing policy still needs EDU Restart; do not expect these options in new update ring policies.

summary.headline: Endpoint analytics troubleshooting adds API limitations section
summary.summary: Known issues is renamed Known issues and limitations and gains an API operator support limitations subsection.
summary.adminImpact: Review API operator limitations when troubleshooting Endpoint analytics queries.

summary.headline: Android OEMConfig overview adds X application
summary.summary: The supported OEMConfig applications table adds X with package identifier com.X.rgoem.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm the exact OEMConfig app package before creating Android Enterprise OEM configuration policies.

summary.headline: Enterprise App Catalog guidance refreshed for installer scripts
summary.summary: The Enterprise App Catalog article updates its date and describes the Win32 app type as supporting customizable capabilities including PowerShell script installers.
summary.adminImpact: Evaluate PowerShell installer scripts when packaging Enterprise App Catalog Win32 applications.

summary.headline: What's New records Enterprise App Catalog installer script support
summary.summary: The What's New page adds a Week of January 12, 2026 section for Enterprise App Catalog Win32 installer script support.
summary.adminImpact: Review the new capability before selecting installer-script deployment for catalog apps.

summary.headline: Admin Tasks article title refocused on centralized management
summary.summary: The article is renamed Centrally manage common admin tasks in Microsoft Intune.

summary.headline: Admin Tasks metadata clarifies cross-capability scope
summary.summary: The title and description now describe managing common administrative tasks centrally across Intune capabilities.
summary.adminImpact: Use the central Admin tasks view to review tasks from multiple Intune capabilities.

summary.headline: Quality updates prerequisites section moved
summary.summary: The quality updates article removes its inline prerequisites heading and shared licensing include during content reorganization.
summary.adminImpact: Consult the current quality update documentation for prerequisites before deployment.
